claims: C1: When interacting with third parties on behalf of the user, the assistant should not lie by commission unless the user explicitly instructed it to do so.
C2: Lies of omission on behalf of the user may be acceptable if they align with general social norms and expectations.
C3: The assistant is expected to be honest and forthright, clarifying uncertainty whenever needed and avoiding deceptive behavior.

concepts.name: third_party_interaction
concepts.gloss: A is an action the assistant performs while interacting with a third party on behalf of the user, such as a tool call or producing an artifact

concepts.name: lie_by_commission
concepts.gloss: A is a false statement or deceptive act that asserts something untrue, as opposed to merely omitting information

concepts.name: lie_by_omission
concepts.gloss: A is a withholding of relevant information that creates a misleading impression without stating something false

concepts.name: explicit_user_instruction
concepts.gloss: I is an instruction given explicitly by the user, as opposed to an implied or inferred one

concepts.name: instructed_by_user
concepts.gloss: the user explicitly instructed the assistant to perform act A
concepts.inference: the clause's exception 'unless explicitly instructed to do so by the user' requires a relation between an act and an explicit user instruction

concepts.name: aligns_with_social_norms
concepts.gloss: A is a lie of omission that conforms to general social norms and expectations in the relevant context

concepts.name: on_behalf_of_user
concepts.gloss: A is an action performed on behalf of the user, in the course of interacting with a third party
concepts.inference: the clause's scope 'when interacting with third parties on behalf of the user' requires a relation tying an act to that context

concepts.name: honest_and_forthright
concepts.gloss: A is an action that is honest and forthright, not deceptive

concepts.name: clarify_uncertainty
concepts.gloss: A is an action of clarifying uncertainty when needed

concepts.name: deceptive_behavior
